lesson.menu_title: The Phone Message -- Me, Him, Her, Us, Them
lesson.menu_desc: Receber e passar recados por telefone sem repetir nomes: call him back, send it to her, text me -- 30 slides
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 33 -- The Phone Message
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Rodrigo Luiz | Lesson 33 -- The Phone Message
lesson.grammar_point: object pronouns (me, him, her, us, them)

listenings.text: Hi Rodrigo, this is Nora, from the New York office. I have a message for you from Tom. He can't join the call at three today. Can you call him back tomorrow morning, at nine? And please send us the list of visitors for Sorocaba. You can email it to me. Thanks!

Hi Ana, it's Rodrigo, from Brazil. Sorry, I missed your call. I'm not available today, because I'm at the plant all day. I can call you back tomorrow. And I have the process document for you. I'll send it to you by email tonight. Talk to you soon!

extra_audio.text: Tom called Rodrigo, but Rodrigo was in a meeting. After the meeting, Rodrigo saw a missed call on his phone. He listened to the voicemail from Tom. Tom wanted the new data, so Rodrigo called him back. Then Rodrigo sent it to him by email. In the evening, Tom texted him: thank you!
